title: EVA cages, pilots, tools and skills
goal: EVA cages with heartbeats, the Marduk pilots, tools and Kaji's watermelons work in the workspace without reloading images on an unchanged poll
acceptance: /api/eva/instances, /api/pilots and /api/tools match live.js; heartbeats keep animating
B-144's check holds in Angular: two polls with the same state keep the cage images and canvases (test)

Kaji's watermelons keeps live skill data (owner 2026-11-26, F-145): the Angular skills panel reads GET /api/skills, keeps the Seed, Sprout, Ripe and Dropped tabs and the empty state "No skills yet. Create one with nerv skills stage <package.json>" (test across the endpoint and the component)

The live thinking state survives the move (F-148): the Angular Pilots panel and sorties read GET /api/thinking on each feed refresh, show pilot, role, model, sortie and a browser-counted elapsed time in both voices with a polite live region, and the EVA cage count never includes it (test across the endpoint and the component)
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: cages, heartbeat canvas and three lists. Not a measurement.
